name: DirichletProcessMixture

args.name: alpha
args.description: The concentration parameter: larger values favor more clusters; smaller values favor sharing

args.name: dist
args.description: The base distribution on component distributions

title: The Dirichlet process mixture distribution
description:
Draw `n` exchangeable observations from component distributions shared according to a Dirichlet process with concentration `alpha`. Each new component distribution is drawn from `dist`. Observations in the same cluster are drawn separately from its shared distribution and need not have identical values.

Supports sampling and use as latent variables in MCMC, but not direct density evaluation or observation of the returned collection.
